description.value: The Ramada by Wyndham Revelstoke is a four-storey chain hotel situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists travelling through the Columbia Mountains corridor. As a Wyndham-branded property it participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty programme and offers standard chain-hotel amenities. Its Trans-Canada location puts it close to Revelstoke's downtown core and the Rogers Pass route.
